svg.title: Deep-Well Circulation Concept
svg.desc: Key: 循环泵 = circulation pump; 热泵 = heat pump; 供热段 = heating/load side; 出水端 = outlet; 入水端 = inlet; 干热岩加热 = heat input from hot dry rock. Downflow/upflow collect underground heat. Concept diagram, not construction detail.
